title: Actual Q3 source polynomial coefficient-product envelope
question: Does the actual shifted Q3 source polynomial embed into a weighted coefficient algebra with norm B, so that formal Cauchy products provide a B^n history envelope without the unavailable central A-context?
method: Reconstruct P=onsite(q,a)+3*edge_u(q,v,a)+6*bond_u(q,v,a) from the registered Q3 potentials and compute its weighted l1 coefficient norm with radii (4,8,1/4), reproducing the EXP-001045 mixed rate.
Construct the source-at-neighbor relabelled polynomial with swapped radii (8,4,1/4) and verify the same exact norm in independent SymPy and Fraction lanes.
Expand P^n and its relabelled counterpart for n=1,2,3,4 and check the formal Cauchy-product bounds ||P^n||<=B^n, then compile Lean R232 for the exact rate and first-passage exponent fixtures.
finding: The actual shifted Q3 source polynomial has weighted coefficient norm B=1382807/7168 in both source orientations. Formal Cauchy products satisfy the exact B^n envelope for lengths one through four, and the separately conditional two-orientation spatial EGF has eta=4148421/896000. The operator-to-coefficient map and factorial Q3 incidence are not proved.
decision_reason: This is the first concrete analytic/Frechet candidate after the central-context inference boundary: it uses actual Q3 polynomial coefficients and avoids commuting growing A-powers through each factor, while explicitly isolating the missing operator realization and spatial history incidence.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing formal analytic/Frechet candidate. It does not prove a Q3 history or thermodynamic QFT.

adversarial_review.check: The onsite, edge and bond source polynomials and spatial multiplicities are reconstructed from the registered Q3 potential.
The weighted l1 coefficient norm is not an unbounded-operator norm and the operator-to-coefficient map remains open.
The relabelled source orientation is computed with swapped field radii and checked independently.
Cauchy product continuity gives a formal B^n envelope only; factorial operator incidence and spatial path counting remain hypotheses.
No same-radius derivative theorem is inferred; EXP-001042's strict radius-loss boundary remains active.
R232 checks finite rate, product-power and exponent arithmetic only.
No thermodynamic dynamics, KMS/OS reconstruction, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.

qft_interface.closed: A formal actual-Q3 source polynomial coefficient envelope with two-orientation relabeling and Cauchy-product B^n control.
qft_interface.open: The operator-to-coefficient realization, factorial incidence, spatial first passage, exhaustion, common alpha, KMS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
